svg.metadata: Ferrosift retrofit module M01-W1; model-derived HLR and solid sections; geometry mm; A3 landscape; Two complementary excitation directions
svg.text: Six functional winding paths: 2 Tx and 4 Rx. Three illustrative perimeter passes per path; unoptimized geometry.
Excitation axis principally Z (out of this view)
B / LOOKING ACROSS Y AT XZ COIL PLANES / 1:2
Excitation axis principally Y (across the lane)
VIEW GEOMETRY: INSULATED PATHS + TERMINAL PINS / BASES; FORMERS OMITTED.
A: ONE Tx + TWO PROPOSED Rx
Illustrative core diameter 0.9, insulation OD 1.4, pitch 3.8. Belt-top gaps Tx/Rx: core 37.85/30.85; insulation 37.6/30.6; terminal pins
37.2/30.2. Returns occupy cut former grooves; retention and manufacture remain unselected.
B: ONE Tx + TWO PROPOSED Rx
Vertical XZ paths provide a complementary transverse axis. Open spiral transitions are not three exact closed turns. Individual start/finish
pins do not define acquisition wiring, polarity or differential pairing. Frequency, balance and useful fields remain unselected.
DIMENSIONS: mm | SCALE PER VIEW AT A3 | PROPOSED RESEARCH GEOMETRY
No approved fit, tolerance, load, electromagnetic coverage, throughput or safeguarding rating.
